resources.name: Quantum chemistry package supporting B3LYP functional, 6-31G* and 6-311+G* basis sets, and Mulliken population analysis (e.g., Psi4 or PySCF)

access.notes: Install via pip (e.g., pip install psi4). The solver may choose any equivalent open-source package that implements B3LYP and the required basis sets.

resources.name: Initial centered icosahedral geometry of Al13-

access.notes: Standard icosahedron: central Al atom surrounded by 12 Al atoms at vertices, bond length ~2.68 Å. The solver must construct the initial Cartesian coordinates from publicly known coordinates.
